open_chapter.method: Click-equivalent on the longest chapter of the heavy seed: open its workspace session and document (dr_editor::SessionSource, warm holder), build the editor, until the frame with the first screen of text is presented. Five opens.

open_book.method: Open every chapter's session and document on all cores (as BookEditor does), build the book view, until the first screen is presented. Three opens: the first loads the holders from SQLite (cold), the others find them open. Heights of off-screen paragraphs are estimated afterwards on a background thread.

keystroke_to_present.method: In-process: the same EntityInputHandler::replace_text_in_range call macOS insertText makes, at 8 chars/s with the key times spread evenly over a 120 Hz frame, in the middle of a paragraph of the longest chapter (every 90th key is Enter); each key is a dr-doc transaction through the workspace session, persisted before the call returns. Stock GPUI timing: the edit marks the window dirty and GPUI draws on the next display-link tick. Measured to the display-link tick after the frame that painted the change. Excludes AppKit event dispatch before insertText.

present_now_comparison.method: Same typing with the present-now hook on: each edit sends setNeedsDisplay to GPUI's view, so Core Animation calls displayLayer and GPUI draws before the next display-link tick. GPUI stops and restarts the display link around that draw, so 'presented' (the next tick) is only an upper bound on this path.

typing_cpu.method: Whole-process CPU time (getrusage user+sys) over the typing run, as percent of one core (the workspace's holder and index threads included).

idle_cpu.method: Editor focused, cursor blinking (530 ms), nothing else happening; whole-process CPU time over the window, as percent of one core.

scroll_full_book.method: From the top of the first chapter to the end of the last, one step of half a viewport per frame, each step issued as soon as the previous frame was presented. work = render start to end of the editor's paint; interval = between consecutive presented ticks.

jump.method: Table-of-contents click equivalent (scroll to the chapter's first item, cursor to its start) until presented; ten jumps, four of them to the last chapter.

memory_mb.method: phys_footprint of the whole process (proc_pid_rusage), MB.

composition.method: In-process pinyin: five setMarkedText-equivalent updates per word, then insertText. Measures each update to presented, the bounds_for_range (candidate window) query, and that the stored body (read on the document holder's thread) is unchanged while marked and grows by exactly the word on commit.
